news.title: OpenAI raises $122 billion to accelerate the next phase of AI - OpenAI
news.zh: OpenAI籌集122億美元以加速AI下一階段發展
news.impact: AI投資大幅增加，推動科技產業創新與競爭加劇

news.title: Spice maker McCormick to combine with Hellmann's maker Unilever in latest food industry shakeup - AP News
news.zh: 香料製造商McCormick將與Hellmann's製造商聯合利華合併，為食品產業最新整合
news.impact: 食品產業整合加速，市場集中度提升，消費者選擇減少

news.title: Hiring just hit a level not seen since the economy was ‘closed down literally’ during COVID, top economist says - Fortune
news.zh: 招聘達到COVID經濟封閉以來未見水準，資深經濟學家表示
news.impact: 勞動力市場緊張，可能推高薪資成本與通膨壓力

news.title: Biogen Snaps Up $5.6 Billion Deal. Why Shares Fell. - Investor's Business Daily
news.zh: 百健以56億美元完成收購交易，為何股價反而下跌
news.impact: 生物製藥整合但市場質疑，投資者對交易價格持保留態度

news.title: Oracle Fires Thousands Of Employees As AI Spending Ramps Up—Shares Rise 2% - Forbes
news.zh: 甲骨文因AI支出增加而裁員數千人，股價上漲2%
news.impact: 科技公司AI轉型持續，結構性調整加強盈利能力

news.title: Mercedes to invest $4 billion in Alabama plant, marks 5 millionth vehicle built in state - Alabama Department of Commerce
news.zh: 賓士在阿拉巴馬州廠房投資40億美元，標誌該州第500萬輛汽車完成
news.impact: 汽車產業投資增加，製造業就業機會擴大，地區經濟提升

news.title: Lilly to acquire Centessa Pharmaceuticals to advance treatments for sleep-wake disorders - Eli Lilly
news.zh: 禮來收購Centessa製藥公司以推進睡眠障礙治療方案
news.impact: 製藥併購活動活躍，新型治療藥物開發加速，患者選項增加

news.title: Europe faces its next big problem: The Iran war is driving up inflation - politico.eu
news.zh: 歐洲面臨下一大難題：伊朗戰爭推高通膨
news.impact: 地緣政治風險引發通膨預期，歐洲經濟增長面臨下行壓力

news.title: War Means Profits for LNG Producers, but Long-Term Challenges - WSJ
news.zh: 戰爭對液化天然氣生產商帶來利潤，但長期面臨挑戰
news.impact: 能源價格上漲刺激LNG盈利，惟供應鏈風險與地緣政治不確定性增加

news.title: US average gas price hits $4 a gallon amid Iran war - Axios
news.zh: 伊朗戰爭推動美國平均汽油價格升至每加侖4美元
news.impact: 油價上升推高通膨預期，消費者支出壓力加大，經濟成長風險上升

news.title: Allbirds is selling for $39M. It raised nearly 10 times that amount in its IPO. - TechCrunch
news.zh: Allbirds以3,900萬美元售出。該公司在IPO中融資金額幾乎是這個數字的10倍。
news.impact: 公司上市後大幅貶值，投資者損失慘重

news.title: China factory activity rebounds in March as Iran war looms over growth - AP News
news.zh: 中國3月份工廠活動反彈，但伊朗戰爭籠罩增長前景
news.impact: 地緣政治風險威脅中國經濟增長，可能影響全球供應鏈

news.title: Uber Technologies, Inc. - Uber to Acquire Global Chauffeur Service Leader Blacklane - Uber Investor Relations
news.zh: 優步科技公司宣布收購全球禮賓車服務領導者Blacklane
news.impact: 優步擴展高端運輸業務，增強市場競爭力

news.title: What You Need To Know Ahead of Ameriprise Financial's Earnings Release
news.zh: 美瑞銀行財務公司財報發佈前需了解的信息
news.impact: 金融機構業績表現將影響市場對金融板塊前景評估

news.title: Meta Platforms (META) to Lay off a Few Hundred Employees
news.zh: 美國Meta平台公司將裁員數百名員工
news.impact: 科技巨頭持續縮減成本，反映行業競爭加劇

news.title: NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) to Supply GPUs to AWS
news.zh: 英偉達公司將向AWS供應GPU
news.impact: 英偉達擴大雲計算市場份額，強化AI晶片供應鏈地位

news.title: Brookfield Renewable Corporation (BEPC) Surged Following a Strategic Partnership with the U.S. Department of Commerce
news.zh: Brookfield可再生能源公司與美國商務部達成戰略夥伴關係後大幅上漲
news.impact: 政府支持可再生能源發展，利好綠能投資前景

news.title: Coeur Mining, Inc. (CDE) Strengthens Portfolio with New Gold Acquisition Following Upgrade
news.zh: Coeur採礦公司在升級後通過新的黃金收購加強投資組合
news.impact: 採礦公司擴展業務規模，增強貴金屬供應能力

news.title: Fired via email? Some of the 30,000 workers cut by Oracle woke up to a morning message saying they were laid off.
news.zh: 甲骨文公司裁減的30,000名員工中有人通過電子郵件被告知失業
news.impact: 科技業大規模裁員，反映IT產業結構調整壓力

news.title: Intel’s stock pops as its latest move signals a ‘turnaround’ is afoot
news.zh: 英特爾股價上漲，其最新舉措信號表明「轉身」正在進行中
news.impact: 英特爾重組計畫受市場看好，有望恢復競爭力

news.title: Deutsche Bank asked AI if it’s true that AI will solve the economy’s inflation problems. The robots answered
news.zh: 德意志銀行詢問人工智能是否真的能解決經濟通脹問題。機器人給出了答案
news.impact: AI能否解決通脹成疑，市場對AI期望可能過高

news.title: ‘Inflationary surge’: Fed economists warn AI hype is overheating the economy whether or not the technology ever delivers
news.zh: 聯邦儲備委員會經濟學家警告，無論技術是否真正實現，AI炒作正在過熱經濟並引發「通脹激增」
news.impact: 聯儲警告AI炒作導致經濟過熱，可能促使政策收緊

news.title: SpaceX has filed confidentially for IPO ahead of AI rivals
news.zh: SpaceX已秘密提交IPO申請，領先於AI競爭對手
news.impact: SpaceX啟動上市計劃，太空產業融資加速

news.title: Record Wind Output Fails to Stop UK Energy Price Surge
news.zh: 英國風力發電創歷史新高但未能阻止能源價格飆升
news.impact: 可再生能源增長仍未解決能源價格上漲問題

news.title: Chipmakers Scramble as Helium Crunch Threatens AI Expansion
news.zh: 芯片製造商面臨困境，氦氣短缺威脅AI產業擴張
news.impact: 氦氣短缺影響芯片生產，AI擴張面臨供應鏈風險

news.title: Prices Sag as US Oil Inventories Climb
news.zh: 美國石油庫存攀升導致油價下滑
news.impact: 石油庫存增加推低油價，能源成本短期向好

news.title: BP's New CEO Pledges Consistency as Company Tries to Rebuild Investor Trust
news.zh: BP新任首席執行官承諾保持一致性，公司努力重建投資者信心
news.impact: BP領導層變更，致力修復投資者關係
